label: EMA highway network: the 2020 Buzzards Bay earthquake (M3.6) from USGS ShakeMap
description: The 2020 M3.6 Buzzards Bay earthquake's USGS ShakeMap, the one recorded map that covers every bridge (it peaks at about 0.003 g, so damage is negligible). Pick another event, or a recent one, from the Earthquakes panel; a map that does not reach every bridge is refused. Sampling fetches the map unless it is cached.

bindings.note: ln SA at the bridges is one Gaussian field: the map's median and sigma at each bridge, correlated by this set (its period matches the IM). Swap for independent.any-im to see what the correlation changes.
One system state per non-key node: it survives if it reaches its nearest key destination within the network's target_add_h of the intact time.
